body:
STRICT review of #8 at 7c7de41: CHANGES. Ticket identity (temp+mv, field 22), exact matching, R74, the acq sweep, no-pgroup and the sccache fd are all verified fixed, and the slotted path has no regression. Blocking:
(1) Priority: only veryhigh was added. Lowercase the value, add lowest, warn on unknown values, add tests.
(2) cargo-kill:269 skips confirmation for --all/--queued/--orphans. Require --yes or a TTY (exit 2 otherwise), and restore the STORY-75 text instead of weakening the contract.
(3) There is no refusal when WRAPPER != the live ~/.local/bin/cargo; add it. The cross-checkout wrapper recognition in cargo-ps/cargo-log is out of scope: revert it or split it into its own PR.
(4) Pid semantics: accept wrapper, flock and child pids in every state by resolving to the wrapper and signalling the wrapper.
(5) Missing tests: real SIGKILLed waiter, 'ai', group confirmation, wrapper refusal, pid cases, priority cases, sccache fd stub.
Keep TASK-JM-004 as its own commit. Mail REWORK READY with the new head.
subject: aida-host PR #8: CHANGES round 1 (5 blocking); read it with aida review verdict STORY-75 in aida-host
